arms.predicted: SA with best-tracking and wider temperature schedule (T0=0.08, T1=0.0005) will score consistently higher than the iter-2 baseline SA (T0=0.05, T1=0.001, no best-tracking). Probe showed 92.7 vs 89.9.
arms.observed: h-main scores: [91.57, 91.58, 92.50, 89.59, 89.39], mean=90.93, stdev=1.36. h-control scores: [89.77, 90.92, 90.91, 90.83, 88.98], mean=90.28, stdev=0.87. h-main wins 4/5 paired comparisons. Mean difference +0.65. Welch t=0.89 (p~0.41, not significant). Cohen's d=0.56.
arms.diagnostic_note: Direction is correct (4/5 wins, +0.65 mean) but magnitude is much smaller than the probe suggested (~3 points vs ~0.65 points). The probe's single-run comparison inflated the apparent effect due to judge variance (~5 points between runs). Best-tracking + wider temps provides a real but small directional advantage. The high variance (stdev 1.36 for h-main) makes statistical significance unachievable with 5 runs at this effect size. Cohen's d=0.56 suggests a medium effect, but ~25 runs per arm would be needed for significance.

arms.predicted: The iter-2 baseline SA (T0=0.05, T1=0.001, no best-tracking) will score in the 88-91 range, consistently below h-main.
arms.observed: Scores: [89.77, 90.92, 90.91, 90.83, 88.98], mean=90.28, stdev=0.87. 4 of 5 runs in predicted 88-91 range, one at 90.92 slightly above. Mean confirms baseline level. Was lower than h-main in 4/5 comparisons but not consistently so.
arms.diagnostic_note: Baseline behaves as expected from iter-2 observations. Mean ~90.3 is consistent with prior iter-2 scores of 88.7-90.6.

discrepancy_analysis: The h-main directional prediction is correct but the magnitude is much smaller than probe-based estimates. Single-run probes during design inflated the apparent effect size (~3 points) because judge variance (~5 point stdev) dominates the real treatment effect (~0.65 points). Best-tracking + wider temps provides a small but real improvement. The super-additivity claim from the design phase (wider temps alone 88.4, tracking alone 91.8, combined 92.7) cannot be confirmed from these multi-run results, as the mean of 90.93 is within noise of the tracking-alone probe value.
